amnesrader: The roof you never climb up to check
Only the roof gets covered, not the whole rig
One person puts this on, not two

blocks.text: The rain sits right at the roof hatch
Rain collects around the roof hatches and seams while the rig sits outside. Nobody finds out until the next moisture check.

blocks.altText: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft

blocks.text: Roof Cover for Travel Trailers & Motorhomes 18–44 ft
The cover only goes over the roof surface, with the edge hanging about 30 to 40 cm (12 to 16 in) down the sides so rainwater doesn't sit at the hatches. It doesn't wrap the walls or windows.
Nine lengths, 18 to 44 ft (5.5 to 13.5 m), so there's one for your roof.
Woven webbing straps with plastic hooks, latched under the edge of the body on all four sides.
Goes on with one person, no second pair of hands needed.
